tracks.legalName: Request to Exclude Case from Online Public Index (CourtView), AS 22.35.030; Alaska Administrative Rule 40(a)
tracks.publicName: Getting a closed case off the public court index

controllingAuthority.summary: The Alaska Court System may not publish a court record of a criminal case on a publicly available website if 60 days have elapsed from acquittal or dismissal and a statutory condition is met. Removal is automatic; TF-810 exists only for when the court system made an error, which the form says in terms.

eligibleDispositions: the defendant was acquitted of all charges filed in the case
all charges were dismissed and were not dismissed as part of a plea agreement in another criminal case under Criminal Rule 11
the defendant was acquitted of some charges and the remaining charges were dismissed
all charges were dismissed after a suspended entry of judgment under AS 12.55.078

the additional Administrative Rule 40(a) grounds, including the underage alcohol offenses and a conviction for possessing less than one ounce of marijuana where the person was at least 21 and was not convicted of any other charge in the case
